content: A mobile app times out during authentication because the OAuth client secret expired. Rotate the client secret and redeploy the application configuration.
Semantic search returns weak matches because new product documents were loaded without rebuilding the vector index. Rebuild the index after the bulk load.
A support assistant returns generic answers when retrieved context is missing. Verify the vector table name, filters, and top_k value before calling the model.
A Python service fails to connect to the vector endpoint because the REST URL omitted the ORDS schema path. Use the full vecdb base URL.
A metadata filter excludes valid search results because the region field used mixed case values. Normalize metadata before upsert.
A reranking step fails because the reranking model has not been loaded. Load a compatible ONNX reranker or skip reranking.
